title: Re: Abracadabraddonna
html:
Quest Giver: Ol' Chuck Pail

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Abracadabraddonna and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 4A: Loins, Keisters, and Pot Bellys. Afterwards, return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Abracadabraddonna and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 4A: Loins, Keisters, and Pot Bellys. Afterwards, return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

Like a rabbit from a hat, or Rotgut from a broken down porta potty, Abracadabraddonna has magically reappeared. Are you interested in hunting her down again and removing her foul existence from this place? Now that you have seen her first hand, chances are she won't fool you with slight of hand or trick mirrors!

Come back to me, Ol' Chuck Pail, here in The Embercore Portal when you have made Abracadabraddonna, and her odd assistants, disappear and I will have something for your troubles.

Turn-in:

Bravo! Encore! Let me know if you want to try this again.

Objectives:

  • Kill Abracadabraddonna
  • Kill Abba Labbas

Client level range: 42–46
